landing.hero.headline: Intelligent document operations for European fiduciaries
landing.hero.description: Fidudoc organizes, validates, and manages client documents automatically—so your team can focus on advisory and compliance work.
landing.problem.title: Every document creates work
landing.problem.point1: Files arrive from everywhere—email, portals, chat
landing.problem.point3: Critical information gets buried in folder structures
landing.solution.title: Automatic document intake and organization
landing.solution.description: Fidudoc handles the full document lifecycle: automatic classification, metadata extraction, compliance validation, and smart organization following your firm's taxonomy.
landing.solution.details: Whether it's VAT invoices, lease contracts, or KYC packs—documents flow through validation workflows and land in the right place with key data already extracted.
landing.solution.note: Built for fiduciary and accounting firms handling hundreds of client documents monthly.
landing.steps.title: How it works
landing.steps.step1.title: Connect your sources
landing.steps.step1.description: Email, Google Drive, OneDrive, client portals
landing.steps.step2.title: Documents get processed
landing.steps.step2.description: Classified by type, validated for compliance, key data extracted
landing.steps.step3.title: Organized and ready
landing.steps.step3.description: Filed correctly with alerts for any issues
landing.principles.title: Built on a simple principle
landing.principles.point1: Software handles repetitive tasks faster than humans.
landing.principles.point2: Humans handle complex decisions better than software.
landing.principles.point3: Fidudoc automates document intake so your team focuses on advisory, compliance, and client relationships—not filing.
landing.closing.title: Fidudoc is currently in pilot with select European fiduciary firms.
landing.signin.title: Sign in
landing.signin.betaMessage: The system is in private beta. Request an invite to get started.
